characters.name: Felicia
characters.direction: Warm and playful; relaxed Gulf Coast delivery. Natural voice, no impersonation.

lines.text: Sweet enough for you. Cold enough for the undead. Welcome in, baby!
These are my packed-ice specials. Six snowballs for one-eighty. Throw them at the zombies, not my trailer!
Six snowballs, coming right up. Keep your aim steady and make those zombies chill out.
Baby, I still have to pay for the ice. Come back when you have one-eighty.
Pick your snowball from the weapon wheel. Aim, then throw. The big ones might need a second helping.
Out of ice? Come see Felicia. I will get you packed up again.
Stay sweet out there, and keep that cold shoulder ready.

characters.name: Chief Jojo
characters.direction: Confident, funny chef; practical warmth. Scene cue times are planning targets, not automatic playback.

lines.text: Welcome to Major Cajun. Chief Jojo runs this kitchen, and nobody leaves hungry.
My zombie gumbo is going to turn this city human again. First, I need you to bring me a few things.
Get the rice from the farmers market. Clear the zombies off the stalls before you grab it.
The farm has our pork order. Pick it up at the gate, and leave the animals alone.
Get the shrimp from the Natchez steamboat dock. Fresh shrimp, not whatever is crawling on the pier.
I need fresh alligator meat. You are going to have to hunt that one yourself.
Ronniebaby has my roux upstairs in the mansion. Take the elevator and bring it back.
You got everything. Bring those ingredients back to Major Cajun.
Now catch me a zombie over at the university. Weaken it, restrain it, and bring it back alive. Do not kill my taste tester!
Rice, pork, shrimp, alligator, and a little of Ronniebaby’s roux. Now we are cooking.
A little roux, a little patience. You cannot rush good gumbo.
A little ice in the bowl. Hot gumbo on top. Let me get my spoon.

lines.cue: Scene 18–24 seconds; record an energetic short take
lines.text: I have the best gumbo in town! The only reason all these people acting like zombies is because they hungry!
Hold on. That is not the reaction I ordered.
Not in my house!
Take that thing outside! You brought it in here, now finish it!
Well, the gumbo did not cure him. But you saved my kitchen. Dinner is on me.

characters.name: Alex
characters.direction: Friendly, precise, curious gunsmith; clipped technical directions.

lines.text: Welcome to AK Gun Plus. I am Alex. Need something reliable, or are we testing something unusual?
Arc Broom or Cajun Thunder. You get thirty seconds of use. The clock keeps running in menus, so make it count.
Your rental is live. Thirty seconds starts now.
Time is up. Your regular weapon is back in your hands.
You are short on game cash. Come back after a job, or take a field trial.
Five waves. I supply the test weapons. You stay alive and show me what they can do.
That wave is clear. New group coming in. Check your weapon!
Final wave. Brutes in the street. Keep moving!
Five waves survived. Solid testing. Here is your pay.
I need a cow, a pig, and a chicken collected safely. Then bring me three live zombie boss specimens.
Bring the marked boss below thirty-five percent health. Get close and hold the restraint action. I need it alive.
That specimen is no use to the lab. I have marked a replacement.
Animals safe, three specimens restrained. Good work. Research pays, and you earned it.

lines.text: Welcome to Slab Motors. Bonnie De Vette here. Come inside and tell me what you are driving.
That ride is yours. Your vehicle is waiting out front. Keep it clean.
Clear my delivery bay first. I cannot put a car on top of another car.
I need a sedan, a sports car, and a Houston slab recovered from the city. I marked the exact cars. Bring each one back intact.
That is not the car I sent you for. Follow the marked vehicle, not a look-alike.
That one needs repairs before I take delivery. Bring it back running right.
That is one back where it belongs. The next car is marked on your map.
Three rides recovered. That is how you do business with Bonnie. Here is your cut.
Drive with some style, and watch my paint.

characters.direction: Conversational stand-up delivery; hold briefly for audience response. Use the performer’s own voice.

lines.text: How is everybody doing tonight? I am Damion. If you are still breathing, that counts as a good crowd.
I made reservations for dinner. The zombies made reservations for me.
Houston traffic is so slow, a zombie asked me if my car was a food truck.
Bonnie told me my trade-in had character. Turns out the character was still in the trunk.
Jojo says her gumbo wakes the dead. I told her to stop offering free refills.
You have been a beautiful, mostly human audience. Get home safe, and tip somebody who still has a pulse.

lines.text: Dayshawn. Elevated Melanin. Welcome in. Keep the trouble outside and let us talk business.
Somebody took my flower, edibles, and concentrates. I marked three sealed shipments. Get my stock back and bring it straight here.
Start by the market. The flower crate is marked. Clear the zombies before you collect it.
Next is the airport freight stop. Find the edible shipment. Keep the case sealed.
Last shipment is by the gas station. Get the concentrate case and bring everything back to Elevated Melanin.
Four zombie bosses across town think they can sell their own product, fucking up my money. University, garage, airport, waterfront. Take those four down, then come see me.
One down. The next rival is marked. Do not lose focus now.
Last one is on the waterfront. Finish it, then bring yourself back in one piece.
All the sealed stock is back. That is how we keep the business moving. Here is your pay.
Four bosses down. My money can breathe again. You earned every dollar.
Finish what you started first. Come back when you can give this job your full attention.
Elevated Melanin. Remember the name, and watch your back out there.
